name: media-row-list
title: Media Row List
description: The pictures or clips a person has added, as rows they can put in order, describe and choose a cover from: each row shows its state in words (an upload's, or one the project names), its progress or its error with pause, resume and retry, a field for its text alternative that can be required, a "cover" choice, a remove button, and room for a status line and controls of the project's own.

meta.when: After a dropzone, when the order of the files matters and each needs a description: the photos of a listing, the slides of a story, the pages of a document. It is ready-made from sortable-list (drag by the handle, lift and move with the keyboard, or the move buttons; every move is read out) and the upload rows of dropzone, and contains no upload engine: the project uploads and passes each row its state. For files whose order does not matter use the dropzone's own UploadList; to reorder things that are not files use sortable-list.
